build_configuration: CUDA 12.8 / MSVC Release / compute 7.5 / C++20 / no fast math
method: Persistent separate workers and stage inputs/owners; sequential alternating stage batches; nonexclusive host.
scope: Synchronized Doppler update and complete native/public predict/PR/Doppler/ESS/conditional B60 resample/estimate or five-epoch history; initialization/restoration/IPC/hash/input setup excluded; every timed weight and returned result hashed; full state at each batch end.
decision: Smaller registers/stack do not improve complete million-particle Doppler likelihood-only steps/five-epoch histories. Keep the original implementation; no additional regression/sanitizers run on this rejected candidate.
selection: Candidate only: gain<=0 and<=64 observations; original positive/NaN gain, KF, >64, PR and all query/resampling/prediction producers retained.
precision_scope: Tested1925 input/state/weights/queued-trajectory records match bits; NaN gain routes to retained original producer and original CUDA fmax clamp gives zero gain, verified against nonpositive gain on both builds; no tolerances relaxed; no new long real-data positioning-error evaluation.
